usage: deskops integrate [-h] [--task TASK] [--task-from-env] [--dry-run]
                         [--root ROOT]

Run the gates of a closed task in a clean copy and push its code commit and closing tip.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --task TASK      Closed task id
  --task-from-env  Take the task id from $DESKOPS_TASK_ID
  --dry-run        Run every gate but print the pushes instead of running them
  --root ROOT      Target repository root.

Examples:
  deskops integrate --task task-x --root . --dry-run
  deskops integrate --task-from-env --root .
